question: What makes the body leap, and what removes its fear of falling?
premises: the body is made to leap by rising-desire-essence of leaping nature
its opposite is the fall, feared
removing that fear-fancy is what lets it leap
inference: Leaping needs only fearlessness toward the opposite fall.
uncertainties: utpluti practice-context (yogic leap) not specified beyond gloss
plain_english: The body is made to leap from the essence of rising desire in leaping impact — by removing the dread of falling to the opposite side.
